program_name: Master of Science in Occupational Safety and Health Management

fees.notes: International total payable fee for the entire programme per UOC official International Fees Structure (includes registration RM2,000, processing RM1,500, administration RM8,000/RM5,000 ODL, EMGS RM2,800 and resource fees); per-year amount not published. Source: https://cyberjaya.edu.my/admission/fees/international-fees-structure (fetched 2026-09-18)

requirements.general: Any of these: Degree in related field (Bachelor's Degree Level): A bachelor’s degree with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 or equivalent, as accepted by the Malaysian government and the University; or A bachelor’s degree in the field or related fields or equivalent with a CGPA between 2.00 to 2.50 can be accepted subject to rigorous internal assessment. Equivalent entries (Certificate): A bachelor's degree in non-related fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 as accepted by the University and with 3 years of relevant working experience, subject to a rigorous internal assessment. Equivalent entries (Bachelor's Degree Level): A bachelor's degree in non-related fields with a minimum of 2.00 as accepted by the University and without relevant working experience, subject to passing prerequisite courses. English Proficiency (For International Students): Band 4 in MUET or equivalent to CEFR (Mid B2).
